Initial release of powpow-register-pcm

- Introduces a guided skill to help users register for a PowPow (Bubble) account and activate their subscription.
- Covers product introduction, screenshot sharing, step-by-step registration walkthrough, error detection, and subscription/payment guidance.
- Handles common registration and activation issues (verification code, username/email conflicts, password format, account activation).
- Skill only provides instructions and support; it doesn't handle actual account creation, digital identity, or code development.
- Clear, user-focused instructions at every step, always ending with a "next step" block and actionable advice.
